release_notes: Tachyon AIO v0.45.23 restores the normal automatic Stable update experience for the private Owner build without weakening the member-versus-owner binary boundary introduced in v0.45.22. Members continue to receive only the public member TachyonAIO.exe from tachyon-releases, with Owner Vault and the private Owner updater physically absent from the compiled member binary. The private Owner build now uses Tachyon's existing staged SHA-256-verified updater against an authenticated owner-only feed hosted by the license authority, so future Stable releases can update Owner installations automatically to the matching TachyonAIO-Owner.exe instead of replacing them with the member EXE. Owner/admin authority entitlements are required for both private manifest and binary download; member and support roles are denied. The tested Owner release candidate is synchronized to the authority by the private Owner publisher, authenticated with a short-lived GitHub Actions OIDC token. The authority cryptographically verifies GitHub's RS256 signature through the published JWKS and binds publication to TheTachyonProject/tachyon-core, refs/heads/main, the exact commit SHA, the Publish Tachyon Owner Build workflow/workflow_ref, allowed event, issuer, token lifetime, and custom tachyon-owner-updates audience. No long-lived GitHub token or authority publishing secret is embedded in Tachyon. Member Build Boundary now downloads the exact compiled member candidate and rejects it if either the Owner Vault marker or private Owner-update transport marker is present. PR #335 passed Architecture Guard, Linux Release Preflight including source/race/vulnerability gates, License Authority V2 including signed OIDC publisher tests, Owner Windows Consumer E2E, Member Windows/WebView2 plus exact-artifact Owner/private-feed exclusion, and CodeQL before merge. Because v0.45.22 intentionally disabled the Owner updater as a temporary safety measure, existing v0.45.22 Owner installations require one final manual replacement with v0.45.23 Owner; after v0.45.23 is installed, future Stable Owner releases update automatically from the private Owner feed.
